sections.title: Opening: Samuel's Death and David's Wilderness Years

blocks.text: Samuel's death at Ramah and burial marks a transitional moment in the narrative. David's subsequent movement into the wilderness of Paran reflects his position as leader of an armed following during a period of flight from Saul. The text places this within Israel's transition from judges-era decentralized leadership toward monarchy, a context where regional leaders with military retinues operated with considerable independence.
